description: Held the missing hand as a bladder until Saturday.
name: Abel Garnish

description: Was not in the room. By the boy's report he agreed to fetch what had come.
name: Gilbert Shakespeare

description: Raye kept the baskets and refused to be added up.
name: William Blackwage, Ralph Raye, Richard Hoope

description: Asked for ten shillings apiece and would not read a list to the yard.
name: John Heminges

description: Reported the butchers' men and the cook, once.
name: Goodwife Margery Pell

description: Stood in the tiring-house door, refused a total, and sent the boy.
name: William Shakespeare
